desc:
A note is markdown too, through the same pipeline a document is — so this is
the same surface asked in a narrower column, under a title.

## A heading in a note

Prose under it: *italic*, **bold**, ~~struck~~, `inline code`, and a
[link](https://example.com) mid-line.

### A third level

- a list item
- another, with **bold**
  - nested
    - [ ] an unchecked task
    - [x] a checked one

> A quote in a note.
>
> > And one inside that.

| option | lead time |
|---|---|
| walnut | six weeks |
| birch | today |
